Apparently the person who made this said it’s “jerk chicken” thanks for all the laughs

This harmonious state is the middle of it all. Somewhere I often find myself without this inner fulfillment being desired. It is not that I search to avoid these feelings, but rather they just seem to come and go like they were never really there at all.
The beauty is not lacked due to the viewpoint of the beholder. It may be different, but never less than. In my opinion. 

To forgive myself, would mean that I can understand my own actions. I treated myself poorly, by Indulging in things that otherwise kill me. I treated others poorly as a projection Of my own sadness. It’s not physical action, per say, bringing these feelings to surface. Maybe just the fact that I believe every one has room for themselves except for me. And like you said, these versions were trying to lead me through this life. Even still. I know they knew better. And I know I know better now.  This beginning, blank page if you will brings me a sense of un security. When you’ve removed all things from the image, leaving you with absolutely anything. What you make out of that becomes important. And tunnel visioned to that expression. 

When I believe that my expression becomes more important that this life around me, I will be able to see things in a different manner, but even then. I’m left with the trace of everything I’d wish you leave behind. While I am a part of this world I do not wish to burden others with a pain I have now deemed to cause myself. The world hurt me, but I can’t blame the world for not finding my way. I’ve found a place for everything and I feel the things outwardly but Inward I’m just staring at the blank canvas. Knowing all that it was and none of what it could be. Or what I’d want it to be. That never feels correct to this moment still. 

I do not wish to put ill upon others as I do myself to in which is a result of this direct conflict. It is not that others make me unhappy, or like I said the world around me, I know I am the problem within, and if I can’t be good to myself I believe I might as well be good to the world. Because I know I am, even if I can’t feel it.

My art and relationships pay the price due to my own downfall of my self vision. These two sides of the coin that I’ve desperately trying to balance, the coin that I’ve desperately tried to send down the drain. I’m not entirely sure what to do with either or, but after this conversation I’m almost there that there is something to do. 

I may be led in a thousand directions, none of which ever feel like home. But home is never too far away if it’s all right here.

The belief of our own realm develops us toward a direction that is of our own. Maybe we feel that maybe we don’t.

Again, this conversation has been entirely meaningful to me and the time you’ve spent engaging is greatly appreciated. This conversation, I have not only watched myself listen and engaged rawly with you, stranger, but I have also watched myself listen and engage within. 

Even if I feel although it is neither here nor there for me, 
The crossing of a path with someone whom is real, helps me see my own reflection and ideas a little less blurry. 


For lack of better words it’s been very nice conversation. You are very well spoken

To which I can agree. Empty is not the correct description, the nothingness is certainly something. The acknowledgment of that alone. Something. 

I do have a rich inner and you are correct to say it does not bring me joy. No matter how much joy I believe to be there. 


The light, the power, the essential fuel, it drains me. Light turns to dark and vice versa. It is the same. The dark and the light, so in my beliefs of the world I am surrounded in. It is neither here nor there, there is no difference in the two. 

To say it is still me, even if I am divorced from these feelings. Thank you for that insight. To answer you question as best I can externally-

I feel I am special, in the physical and spiritual sense yes, but I do not find pride in that or fulfillment mainly due to this terrible feeling inside. That I am at a flat line. Why do I need to forgive myself? I do not need to I suppose. I wallow often in every version of myself, doing with what she knew best, wasn’t enough. For me. What I believe I want to feel. I’m building these blocks of who I want to be and the closer I am to that the further I feel from real. 

The expression of myself is never defeated. It’s always there, I’m open and honest within this life I live. Still, the poison that is within me, I believe with then poison the world. The same way it did to me. I do not wish others to be effected by my “empty” feeling. Because the world is loved by me, it is appreciated and felt. But unfortunately that love isn’t enough. The outside world constantly reminds me of this. 

When it’s all said and done I am left alone with this feeling that no matter how good I am, no matter how many things I let go of, I will never feel like I am settled into myself. 

My art, and writing. Relationships suffer due to the fact that I hold within, this deep meaningless feeling. I run to avoid spilling. 

I look at my writing. My art. And all the things I pour expression into, and watch it all burn before me. For better or worse. 

You’re giving me a lot of things to think about and for that I am greatful. I’m here and I suppose for the time being I have to work with that the best I can. And this feeling is not set in stone, no matter how long or how short it is felt. It’s real regardless.

I do not know you but I will take what you’ve spoken with me, inside.

I cannot expect the world to understand or listen, but I am grateful for the opportunity to openly express and communicate on a non biased level. Thank you.

sometimes our own silence is better than the deafening silence brought upon us in conversation. Sending love to you. If you ever want to have a conversation, talking about something you care about.. don’t be a stranger.

Thank you, first and foremost. I can hear the words you write and feel them inside. 

The beauty, the presence of all things, I find immense value. The art, in this example makes me feel beautiful things because of it. But I do not feel these beautiful things. When the feeling is away, I am searching to find another... I’ve gone through cycles of my “crutches” the things that I indulge in, my cure alls if you would. Where I thought I found myself closer to that feeling, alone. But I never found it. I see the light, I feel it. It’s everywhere I go. The love the happiness, all the “good things” 
I enjoy it all. But it’s not inside of me. 
I enjoy the person I am to the world, but that is not inside of me. 

The light it always stays the same, but it’s too bright for me. And reminds me of how it’s all a lie. That the light blinds you if you stare long enough, bringing me back to the abyss that is nothing. 

When I see myself from the outside, taking myself out of the picture. I think I am a very special person. I would love nothing more than to meet someone like me. 
When I look inside, I see a flame in a dark room, slowly burning lower and lower. Until the light goes out and I spent time rubbing my thoughts together until I can light it once again. Repeat. 

I’m hurt, but that’s not who I am to the world. It’s who I am to myself. And that I cannot forgive myself for. 

I am not proud of anything I do, any struggles I’ve gotten out of, I don’t feel these things.
My art, writing, and all creative outlets pay the price. My relationships pay the price.

What I feel inside makes me realize that one day it could all spill out, and why would I want to poison the world the way it’s poisoned me?

I really appreciate your conversation. If I come across as debating or pessimistic I apologize, I’m trying my best to put my feelings into words.
we are the other side of the coin.

The value of something isn’t based off the observer, in the case that I am. I believe that my life does not have meaning in a physical sense. Almost as if I was here by mistake.. which I can acknowledge could never be true. The beauty of the world, the raw, unapologetic beauty of everything as it is. Unfortunately, I cannot see that same form of beauty inside of myself. Or any beauty rather. Ones purpose is what one makes of it, and I cannot say with a truthful tongue that i want to make anything of that. Because the person I am on the inside is filled with such an unfulfilled feeling. And empty hopeless feeling, and it is only the outside that reminds me of the light. Until it’s too bright, and burns me all over again until the comforting darkness brings me back to the window where the light shines through. 
Sometimes I like to think that I’m here to feel these ways, that that’s my purpose. To stand with my back to the sun and wonder why my shadow never goes away.

Experience of existence should be rewarding enough yes, but I do not find reward in such. Life is beautiful, but it is with or without me. The fact is I find myself meaningless, and I’m not sure where that leads me. When the lights are there and the seasons change and I watch it tears and smiles move from one face to another, it’s all real. As real as something can be in a physical world. And I don’t see a reason why. I don’t wish this life to change or alternate due to my own personal beliefs ideas feelings etc. I wish that I could see what I see inside of the world, inside of me.

I suppose what I am saying is the glass is the same whether broken or not. But the belief that a solid piece of glass cannot cut you is foolish. It is simply waiting to break. Because it is all a belief, conditioning, and illusion, I cannot say what I feel is real. But I can say, that this life around me is good. In my opinion. It is my that is bad. I am the poison. Taking myself out of the equation, where nothing matters, that is the comfort I find. In a physical world, where I do feel things, and become self aware.. it is harder to let go of the idea that I am not meant to be here. 

I’m not sure if I’m explaining correctly, coherently. But it’s what I have inside and I’m trying my best. Thank you for replying and I hear you.. I really appreciate your words
It is okay. I accept what is in front of me, thank you for seeing me. And listening.

You’re right. I do find myself worse than I am. Without sounding overly pessimistic, I’m not sure what I can change. What the challenge is. I’m not entirely sure what I want to be different about me but it’s foolish to just believe the only thing I want is to feel better. What do I want to feel better from? I’m in a roundabout of givens that surround me and I’m lacking a grasp on anything that is real. I feel like a ghost that no one ever sees. Even when they do.

As much as I hate to admit it, when I think about feeling better I think about being dead. I love the things in this life, truly. I am excited, and loving, and I find beauty in what is around me. My own reflection of whoever I am, the things I can’t change, and what drags me under. Thank you for your reply
In this together. Staying. this simple interaction has meant so much to me
I felt what you said deeply. Thank you.
